summary: This sermon explores the Hebrew concept of 'Shema' from Deuteronomy 6, teaching that listening to God means both hearing and responding through action. The pastor connects this to Jesus' teaching on the greatest commandment—loving God with everything you are and loving your neighbor as yourself—showing that genuine faith requires obedient response, not just intellectual agreement.
key_points: Shema means listening AND responding, not merely hearing
The greatest commandment: love God fully and love your neighbor as yourself
Everyone is your neighbor regardless of differences
True listening to God requires changed actions
The gospel says we're accepted, therefore we obey
big_idea: True faith means not only hearing God's command to love Him fully and love our neighbors, but actively responding through obedient action in daily life.
title: Shema - Listen and Respond
